target.description: Resolve CDLB 2006:1 as one exact research Work, preserve its two A01 roles, reconstruct its metrological method without admitting the result as sign truth, and test the argument against current CDLI edition history, PCSL identity, Unicode status, rights, and 2024-2026 relevance.
required_properties: exact article title, author, journal identity, publication date, and PDF version date
article-text rights separated from artifact-image and technical-resource rights
source-reported N16 calculation chain with intermediate, final, indeterminate, and hypothetical cases
current CDLI transcription and revision state for every decisive artifact
current PCSL identity and count with parameter limitations
current-final and next-draft Unicode status without importing proposal coordinates as facts
acceptable_substitutions: the publisher PDF for exact argument and version verification
current CDLI artifact and history pages for later transcription state
current PCSL and official Unicode data only as technical controls

channels.source_name: Unicode final and beta standards, proposal history, and targeted 2024-2026 scholarly search
channels.interface_version: Unicode 17.0 final and Unicode 18.0 beta UCD checked 2026-08-12
channels.exact_query: Distinguish current-final Unicode 17 from future Unicode 18; verify whether N16 survived into the stable beta repertoire; search 2024-2026 primary scholarship for an exact N16 metrological reassessment and reject generic non-comparable AI papers.

declared_rights.statement: Unicode terms apply; no standard data is republished.

results.rationale: Unicode 17.0 is the current final standard on the research date and contains no proto-cuneiform numeral repertoire or N16 character.

snapshot.reason: The official final-version route is cited without importing UCD content.

declared_rights.statement: Unicode technical-document and data-file terms apply; no beta data is republished.

results.rationale: The stable beta repertoire is still not a final standard and its official UnicodeData contains no N16 entry, despite an N16 character appearing in the older L2/23-190 proposal.

snapshot.reason: Currentness is preserved through dated official references; no UCD or chart data entered ToS.

channel_comparison.notes: Complete for Work identity, responsibility, publication and PDF-version dates, issue, citation, journal scope, and article rights. The author profile has no ORCID or institution, so broader identity remains provisional.

Complete section-level direct evidence for the argument, its classical unit substrate, later Cornell publication coordinates, rejected intermediate result, final proposal, indeterminate case, and hypothetical N17 extension. No content was imported.

The decisive P006303 reading drift and current PCSL identity/count were resolved. PCSL's certificate chain required a transport fallback after indexed public results, but no access control was bypassed and no payload was acquired.

Official current-final, next-beta, repertoire, and proposal-history states were separated. No exact 2024-2026 N16 metrological reassessment was located; this remains a bounded search result, not literature completeness.
